::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jan. 1. 1867  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book British Library Add MSS.55386 (2) P. 754
:::

My dear Miss Yonge,                                                                       

I omitted yesterday to say that I had sent to [your bankers](organizations/other_169.qmd) the amount of £275 – due at midsummer.

Also that I am reading [Miss Peard](people/person_1160.qmd)’s “[story of Prayer Book](other_books/otherbook_464.qmd)” , and I hope with perhaps a little modification, it may come well into [our Series](organizations/other_145.qmd), but not early.

With all kind New Year wishes

Yours very faithfully

[A. Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd)

&nbsp;
